The iPhone Duo was officially unveiled in early September, but as its October launch date approaches, we're continuing to learn more details about the device. The latest piece of news is a preview of the iPhone Duo's two-page PDF viewing experience.

Leak reveals the iPhone Duo's PDF features will be richer

If you're interested in the iPhone Duo, chances are it's because you want it to do things your current iPhone can't.

For example, many people need to handle PDF files frequently for work or school. But the experience of reading PDFs on a traditional iPhone leaves much to be desired.

By comparison, the iPad performs excellently when it comes to PDFs. So how will the iPhone Duo fare?

Leaker pdfu has posted a video showing the iPhone Duo's PDF Quick Look feature in the new two-page mode.

Two-page layout is useful in many situations. But I expect the iPhone Duo will be just as excellent for viewing PDFs in single-page mode.

Especially once Apple Pencil support rolls out later this year, the iPhone Duo has a chance to become the first iPhone to truly offer an outstanding PDF experience.

Are you planning to use the iPhone Duo to read PDFs all the time? What other tasks that your current iPhone can't handle would you like it to excel at? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments.
